verdict.rationale: Increase issues cards and processes ACH, so a dispute-handling story is a fair question for this product. The evidence pack never mentions card disputes or chargebacks, ACH dispute or unauthorized-debit claims, Reg E investigation timelines, provisional credit, or documented ops responsibilities. ACH and check return correlation (docs-39) is an adjacent exception-tracking feature, not dispute handling, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an ops user, card and ACH disputes are handled properly — Reg E investigation timelines, provisional credit mechanics, and my operational responsibilities documented and tooled
